reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-team. I said I can't confirm the 18 August deadline he overheard for the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines. Nothing he has access to mentions an "Osprey" rollout or that date. That means the brain, the public files and the channels he's in.

I also pointed him to the people who could confirm it: Dana Okafor, who owns the account, or Ilse Varga, who leads the North team. I didn't read the North team or QFL incident channels, because Tobias isn't a member of them, so they might hold something I didn't check.
